title: Grateful Dead Live at Glens Falls Civic Center on 1982-04-14
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition CC 2021 > TLH flac2496
source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S)

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a high‑energy show featuring the rare electric Deep Elm and an unforgettable TLEO solo.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised as one of the better audience recordings, with enough clarity that it could serve as a matrix source alongside a soundboard. The performance shines thanks to the rare electric Deep Elm, Bobby's witty opening statement, and a perfectly executed TLEO solo, making it a standout for fans who know every note.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review highlights both an outstanding performance and high‑quality audience recording, warranting a strong rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as one of the better audience recordings; clear enough to be paired in a matrix with a soundboard, no noted dropouts or major issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific complaints; reviewers emphasize the overall excitement and rarity of the set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Solo on TLEO highlighted as flawless and memorable.
band_member_comments.Bob: Opening statement noted as hilarious, adding to the show's charm.
